references.text: Pillars with silver hooks and bases of copper are also mentioned in connection with the curtain of the tabernacle, showing the same pattern of materials.
Earlier in the same chapter, the pillars on the north side and south side of the courtyard are described with silver bands, silver hooks, and bases of copper.
The parallel verse describes the actual construction of the courtyard pillars with silver bands, silver hooks, and bases of copper.
Describes the construction of the courtyard pillars with hooks and bands of silver, in accordance with the instructions.
Mentions copper as the material for the sockets of the tabernacle and the courtyard, showing the consistent use of copper in the foundational structure.
The specification of the south side's construction elaborates on the general instruction regarding the materials of the courtyard.
The instruction for the north side confirms that the material requirements were universal for the entire courtyard.
The execution of the entrance area shows that the same principles for material use applied to all entrances of the sanctuary.
The actual construction of the south side confirms obedience to God's specific instructions.
The actual construction of the north side confirms that the work followed God's precise plan.
The west wall confirms that the material principles were consistent on all sides of the sanctuary.
The contrast between the silver of the courtyard and the gold of the sanctuary marks the gradual holiness in approaching God.
